notes: Direct mappings are to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API clauses for object registration, object-name lookup, and resignation. The behavior assertion is limited to the FederateOwnsAttributes rejection boundary for NO_ACTION while the federate owns an instance attribute; it does not claim a broader resignation-action matrix.

requirements.statement: The standard resignation service declares FederateOwnsAttributes. With a second federate remaining joined so the final-federate rule does not apply, the test expects this exception when the object-owning federate requests NO_ACTION, then verifies the object remains queryable before a subsequent DELETE_OBJECTS resignation.
The test registers a published object instance to establish the owned-attribute precondition for the resignation rejection check.
After the rejected resignation, a successful standard name lookup confirms the federate remains a member and still knows the registered object.
